Secure checkout and payments for subscriptions, built by Ecom Swift LLC. We connect the Subscribe button in your app to your payment provider, so a customer can pay safely and the account upgrades as soon as the payment is confirmed.

## What is a subscription checkout?

A subscription checkout is the page or form where a customer enters payment details and agrees to be charged on a repeating schedule. It sits between the pricing page and the paid account. When it works, the customer clicks Subscribe, pays, and lands inside the product with the right plan switched on. When it fails, the customer sees an error, or pays and still has a free account.

Most providers offer two ways to build it: a hosted page that lives on the provider's own domain, and an embedded form that sits inside your own page. Both keep card details away from your server. That matters for security and for the amount of compliance work you carry.

## Why checkout quality decides whether people finish paying

Checkout is the narrowest point of the whole funnel. Everyone who reaches it has already decided they want the product, so every confusing field, missing payment method or vague error message turns a ready buyer into a lost sale. Small details count here: whether Apple Pay or Google Pay appears on a phone, whether the total is clear before the button is pressed, and whether a declined card gets a helpful message instead of a generic failure.

The connection back to your app matters just as much as the page itself. If the app only trusts the browser redirect, a customer who closes the tab after paying may never be upgraded. The reliable method is to wait for the provider to confirm the payment through a server-to-server event, then change the account. That is how revenue and access stay in step.

## What a good checkout includes

- A hosted page or embedded form that keeps card details off your own server.
- Card payments, with wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay where your provider supports them.
- Local payment methods and bank debits for the countries you sell to, where available.
- A success page that confirms the plan and tells the customer what happens next.
- A cancel page that returns the customer to pricing without losing their place.
- A receipt email sent right after payment.
- Clear messages for declined, expired or insufficient-funds cards.
- Strong customer authentication, so bank approval steps in Europe and similar regions complete properly.
- Protection against duplicate charges when a customer clicks twice or refreshes.
- Your logo and colors, so the page feels like part of your product.

## How we set it up

We start by reading how your app creates accounts and plans today, or by agreeing a simple structure if it is new. Then we create the checkout session in your provider account, using your plan prices. The Basic package uses the provider's hosted page with cards enabled. The Standard package adds your branding, wallets, receipts and friendlier error messages. The Premium package embeds checkout in your own page and adds extra local payment methods, duplicate-charge protection and a handover call.

Every package ends with testing. We run payments through your provider's test mode with test cards, including cards that decline and cards that ask for extra authentication. We confirm the account upgrades once, and only once, per payment. Ecom Swift LLC does not handle or hold your customers' money: the funds go from the customer to your provider and then to your own bank account.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep the number of fields as small as the provider allows.
- Show the plan name, billing period and total before the customer pays.
- Offer the payment methods your buyers already use in their own country.
- Upgrade accounts from the provider's confirmed event, not from the browser redirect alone.
- Test with declining and authentication-required cards before going live.

**Avoid:**
- Collecting card numbers in your own form or storing them yourself.
- Sending customers to a cancel page that dead-ends with no way back.
- Hiding tax, fees or the renewal date until after the button is pressed.
- Showing a raw provider error message to a customer.
- Switching to live mode before the full flow has passed in test mode.

## Who this suits

This service suits a founder whose product is ready but has no way to take payment yet. It suits a small SaaS team that currently collects payments by hand or by bank transfer and wants the account to upgrade automatically. It also suits an app that already takes payments but has a plain checkout with few payment methods, and wants it cleaned up, branded and extended.

## What we need from you and how to start

Tell us which payment provider you use or plan to use, which plans you sell, and which countries your customers pay from. Send your logo and brand colors if you want a branded page. We need access to your app's code as a developer or collaborator user, and a team or developer role in your provider account. We never need your passwords, and we never need to see full card numbers. After you order, we reply with a short checklist and keep you updated until checkout is tested and ready.
